borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Construction of a single storey modular building (Use Class F2) for a temporary period of 5 years
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Proposed Ground Floor Plan -&nbsp;100/002 - dated January 2026</li><li>Proposed Roof Plan -&nbsp;100/003 - dated January 2026</li><li>Proposed Elevations -&nbsp;100/004 - dated January 2026</li><li>Proposed Section A-A -&nbsp;100/005 - dated January 2026</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Block&nbsp; Plan -&nbsp;100/200 - dated January 2026</li><li>Location Plan - ref: PP-14607133v1 - dated 13 Jan 2026</li><li>Bird's Eye View Image -n.d.</li><li>H.M. Land Registry - dated 7th Jan 2026</li><li>Title register&nbsp;- dated 7th Jan 2026</li><li>Cover Letter - dated 13th Jan 2026</li><li>Heritage Statement - n.d.</li><li>Community Benefit Statement - n.d.</li><li>Ecological Walkover Statement - ref:&nbsp;26_ECO_01_80 - 04/02/2026</li><li>
Design and Access Statement - dated 12/01/2026</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Planning permission is granted for a period of 5 years. On or before the expiry of the relevant 5-year period the use hereby permitted shall be discontinued.&nbsp;</span></span>A lightweight, reversible foundation system, with pads or screw piles, must also be used for the construction of the temporary proposal.&nbsp;</p><p style="text-align:justify"><br></p>

<p>No demolition or development shall take place until a written scheme of</p><p>investigation (WSI) has been submitted to and approved by the local planning</p><p>authority in writing. For land that is included within the WSI, no demolition or</p><p>development shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed WSI,</p><p>which shall include the statement of significance and research objectives, and</p><p>A. The programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and</p><p>the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the</p><p>agreed works</p><p>B. Where appropriate, details of a programme for delivering related positive</p><p>public benefits</p><p>C. The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent</p><p>analysis, publication &amp; dissemination and deposition of resulting material.</p><p>This part of the condition shall not be discharged until these elements have</p><p>been fulfilled in accordance with the programme set out in the WSI</p>
